Services / ServiceNow & Enterprise Tooling
02 · build

Enterprise platform work most agencies can't touch

ServiceNow instances get complex fast — customizations pile up, conflicts go undetected, and generic dev agencies don't have the platform-specific depth to help. We do.

Start a project →
the problem

ServiceNow environments accumulate customizations from multiple teams over years. Conflicts between them are hard to catch before they break production, and most software agencies simply don't have the platform expertise to diagnose, let alone fix, these problems.

our approach

We bring real depth on ServiceNow semantics — CMDB, SAM, platform architecture — not a generalist's surface-level familiarity. That means we can build detection and resolution tooling that actually understands what a customization is doing, not just pattern-matching on code that looks risky.

what's included
01

Conflict detection tooling

Custom scanners that catch customization conflicts before deployment, built on real static analysis, not guesswork.

02

Platform customization

Scoped apps, workflows, and integrations built to ServiceNow best practices.

03

CMDB & SAM work

Configuration management and software asset management scenarios handled with platform-level fluency.

04

Security & correctness audits

Reviews for common ServiceNow pitfalls — auth gaps, data leakage, logic errors — before they become incidents.

05

AI-assisted resolution systems

Where useful, resolution tooling with human-review UX, deployment snapshots, and observability layered in.

06

Ongoing platform support

Continued maintenance and troubleshooting as your instance evolves, available through Managed Digital Support.
